home.flagshipFallDesc: Guarding high-risk, lethal bathroom and washroom zones. Radar penetrates steam and darkness to capture posture collapse in milliseconds, sounding local sirens and dispatching alerts.

home.flagshipFallPoint2: High-decibel local alarm + simultaneous multi-channel push to phones and care platforms

aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.lead: Tsinghua-derived Technology · Multi-modal contactless monitoring · Precision Health Monitoring
aboutPage.introBody: Zhongke Anqiao (Suzhou) Technology Co., Ltd. integrates R&D and sales of medical devices, office intelligence, health management, smart medical integration, elderly rehabilitation, mobile applications and smart prevention health-monitoring software. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, the company was incubated within the Suzhou Advanced Technology Research Institute.
aboutPage.techBody: The company is building a digital health management center and a professional R&D team, progressively developing key devices covering smart health fast-pass, contactless rapid health screening, health mother-and-child units and microfluidic health fast-pass. In deep cooperation with Suzhou Institute of Biomedical Engineering, it jointly develops routine monitoring and promotion programs for children's and adolescents' health, adopts Tsinghua's sleep mmWave radar technology, and launches data-driven medical-eldercare integrated sleep monitoring R&D — officially initiating the core AI Health Guardian device R&D program.

qualityStages.promise: Quality issues / damaged / wrong item → free replacement
12-month warranty policy, special cases determined separately

aboutPage.certBody: The company holds a medical device business filing certificate (qualified to sell Class II medical devices).
aboutPage.teamBody: Zhongke Anqiao's core R&D team hails from prestigious institutions including Tsinghua University and the Chinese Academy of Sciences Suzhou Institute, bringing profound expertise in microwave RF, bioradar signal processing, and medical health algorithms.

history.title: Company founded
history.body: Founded at the Suzhou Advanced Technology Research Institute, established a digital health-management center and a professional R&D team, progressively refining key devices: smart-health rapid channel, contactless rapid screening, health parent-child device and microfluidic health rapid channel.

history.title: Core project initiated
history.body: Innovatively launched the Elderly Health Guardian series; in-depth cooperation with Suzhou Institute of Biomedical Engineering and Technology on routine child and adolescent health monitoring; adopted Tsinghua's sleep mmWave radar technology and initiated data-driven medical-eldercare sleep monitoring R&D; the core AI Health Guardian project was formally launched.

history.title: Product matrix complete
history.body: Leveraging R&D outcomes from the Shenzhen Advanced Technology Research Institute, independently completed the microfluidic white-blood-cell analyzer and multi-function smart nursing-bed software; achieved modular embedding of life-monitoring functions, developed transfer equipment, pulse-massage chairs and more; in deep cooperation with Southeast University on core components for a high-frequency ECG waiting-room chair.
